description: The Thue-Morse run that contains n. The bit is the parity of the 1-bits of n. A run has length 1 or 2. Index 0 is a run of one 0, and index 1 starts a run of two 1s. n runs from 0 to 1000000. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/morse-run
